description: This file defines the DatabaseConfigController class, which extends AbstractInstallerVueController. It handles the pre-render step for the database configuration screen in the installer process, setting up the Vue component and updating the state container.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigController
classes.description: Controller for managing the database configuration stage during installation. It prepares the Vue component for the database config screen and updates the state container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the database configuration Vue component and updates the current screen state before rendering.
